description.en: Approximately 63 km from Sofia to the Serbian border at Kalotina, on European route E80 and Pan-European Corridor X. It was called the Kalotina motorway until it was renamed in 2018. Dragoman–Slivnitsa was built by GBS-Infrastructure and opened in November 2020; Kalotina–Dragoman went to the Strabag BPA consortium under a contract signed in November 2018 and opened in October 2023. The associated Sofia Northern Bypass opened in April 2016.

money.note: Design-and-build contract, excluding VAT. 164.99 million including VAT.

value.note: Design-and-build contract, excluding VAT. 164.99 million including VAT.

note.en: Contract durations converted from days: 852 days total, 122 days design. The contract deadline was January 2022; the section opened to traffic in October 2023 with Act 16 still pending. The builder is the Strabag BPA consortium of Strabag EAD, Strabag Sp. z o.o. (Poland) and Bitumina GmbH-Bulgaria.
note.ro: Durate contractuale convertite din zile: 852 de zile în total, 122 de zile proiectare. Termenul contractual era ianuarie 2022; secțiunea a fost deschisă circulației în octombrie 2023, cu Actul 16 încă în așteptare. Constructorul este consorțiul Strabag BPA, format din Strabag EAD, Strabag Sp. z o.o. (Polonia) și Bitumina GmbH-Bulgaria.

money.note: Design-and-build contract, excluding VAT. 117.36 million including VAT.
